newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila central bank says no overnight rate changes.
newsitem.headline: Manila central bank says no overnight rate changes.

text.p: Philippine central bank governor Gabriel Singson said on Friday there were no changes in overnight lending and borrowing rates.
Speaking at a news conference, Singson said there were substantial dollar inflows into the country.

The central bank has cut its benchmark overnight borrowing rate twice this week. The latest cut which became effective on Friday took the rate down to 25 percent. Ahead of this week's reductions, the rate stood at 32 percent.
